image_description: An interior view of a rustic, wooden lumbermill or sawmill. A man in work clothes (blue shirt, jeans, cap) stands operating a large, vintage band saw mechanism. A large log is positioned on the carriage track leading into the saw. The building features exposed timber framing, wooden walls, and a dirt/sawdust-covered floor. Sunlight streams in through windows in the background, creating high contrast.
